data.name: Worldforge : Construct & Destroy
data.detailed_description:
Worldforge : Construct & Destroy is a physics-driven voxel sandbox where you can create, program, destroy, experiment, and reshape fully destructible worlds.

Build massive structures, design intricate environments, generate voxel creations through code, and watch voxel buildings break apart under physics-driven destruction.

Every creation can become an experiment and every structure can be pushed beyond its limits.

Create

Shape your own voxel worlds using the integrated editor and sandbox building tools.

Construct buildings, environments, props, experimental structures, and custom voxel models directly inside Worldforge.

For more advanced creation, the integrated RVS scripting system allows you to write real code that generates voxel models and structures. Scripts are not limited to isolated programming puzzles, the same system can be used inside the main editor to create practical content, save your work, and prepare creations for the Steam Workshop.

Programming Challenges provide guided objectives for learning and mastering RVS scripting, beginning with accessible tasks and gradually introducing more advanced construction techniques.

Additional creative and non-programming challenges will continue to expand Worldforge over time.

Creation Features

  • Interactive voxel editor

  • Sandbox building and editing tools

  • Integrated RVS voxel scripting

  • Code-generated models and structures

  • Programming and creative challenges

  • Saveable challenge solutions

  • Moddable content and custom creations

  • Steam Workshop support

Destroy

Explore physics-driven voxel destruction in the included city sandbox.

Damage structures, tear through voxel buildings, create debris, and observe how destruction unfolds through the physics simulation.

Buildings do not rely entirely on fixed destruction animations. Voxel sections can break apart, fall, collide, and react dynamically as structures are damaged.

Destruction Features

  • Fully destructible voxel buildings

  • Real-time physics-driven destruction

  • Dynamic voxel debris

  • Structural breakage and collapse

  • Destructive city sandbox

  • Emergent physics interactions

  • Large-scale demolition experiments

Experiment and Overcome Challenges

Worldforge is designed for more than freeform building and destruction.

Challenge Mode introduces structured objectives across programming, creation, experimentation, and future gameplay systems. Solve challenges, discover new techniques, unlock achievements, and apply what you learn to your own creations.

Whether you want to construct towering structures, program voxel models through code, solve creative challenges, publish custom creations, or experience the satisfaction of tearing a voxel city apart, Worldforge : Construct & Destroy gives you the tools to create and the freedom to destroy.

WorldForge Labs

WorldForge is also the foundation of WorldForge Labs, an expanding collection of optional creative and experimental tools.

WorldForge Labs explores areas beyond voxel construction, including music, visual processing, digital media, procedural creation, and other experimental technologies developed within the WorldForge ecosystem.

Lab tools are distributed separately, so the main WorldForge installation remains focused and lightweight. Each tool can provide its own specialized workflow while remaining connected to the wider WorldForge platform.

data.short_description: Build, destroy, and experiment in a physics-driven voxel sandbox featuring fully destructible environments, dynamic combat, explosive chain reactions, and creative sandbox gameplay.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 Ti / AMD RX 560 / Intel Arc supported
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended. Integrated GPUs may run at reduced settings.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: : Intel Core i7-9700 / AMD Ryzen 5 5600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3060 / AMD RX 6700 XT or better
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: Recommended for large-scale destruction, high debris counts, advanced lighting, and future GPU features.
